summary: Analyzer consumes manifest ids without prechecking coverage for all runtime tensor ids (issue594_analyze_context_geometry.py:865) — late KeyError on any missing id.

deferral_rationale: Severity downgrade BLOCKER->NIT (r1 reconcile): the uncovered state is unreachable through the registered writer — extract's assemble phase loads every per_probe/<iid>.pt before writing the mean blob, and each manifest row is written in the same per-instance checkpoint as its tensor; any residual gap fails loud (KeyError/FileNotFoundError) before stats, in a free re-runnable off-pod phase. Claude reviewer independently re-ran the analysis end-to-end over all 50 ids. A missing-id precheck is polish, not a gate.
